title: Vow and Summer
author: Silas Ashgrove
blurb: Lena Voss, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the bakery lease runs out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
